wiki_article:
**Living Architecture Lab — livingarchitecturelab.org** is a software and executable apparatus deposit by Lee Sharks, dated 28 April 2026, holding the complete source of the Lab's site.

The Living Architecture Lab is one of the archive's institutional surfaces — an entity with a name, a domain and a public presence, established so that a body of work has somewhere to be attributed to. The archive maintains a fleet of these, and the surface-binding specification (#1419) later bound each of them to a versioned repository twin with bidirectional identity assertion.

The body was recovered on 4 August 2026 from the live surface, with the served page's SHA-256 recorded in the deposit so the capture can be checked against what the site actually returned. The deposit is the archival capture; the site remains the live manifestation.
